text: PRAY FOR PEACE IN THE MIDDLE EAST, GAZA & UKRANE" & KEEP THE USA OUT FOR NOW. 🇨🇦 ELBOWS UP & CARNEY ON - NOW A MAJORITY GOVERNMENT - THANK YOU DONALD FOR HELPING US ELECT OUR PM.🇨🇦🇨🇦🇨🇦 Virtually all political systems are divisive, each striving for power. With a clear insightful vision of Canadas future, he is uniting Canadians and drawing members of Parliament to cross the floor into his "Circle of Unity” to Serve our Nation. I'm blessed to be alive at this historic moment and moved to share this Vision of Canadas destiny, written 109 years ago. 🇨🇦 February 21, 1917, "To the Baha'is of Canada and Greenland. “...the future of the Dominion of Canada, however, is very great, and the events connected with it infinitely glorious. It shall become the object of the glance of providence, and shall show forth the bounties of the All-Glorious .. Again I repeat that the future of Canada, whether from a material or a spiritual standpoint, is very great. Day by day civilization and freedom shall increase…” For the full Tablet, Google "Tablet to the Baha'is of Canada and Greenland.” In all the voluminous original Holy Writings of the Baha’i Faith, no other Country has received such praises, which had attracted me when I became a Baha’i in 1962. Now 87, I never expected it beginning in my life time, and am so thankful to be living in our multi cultural peaceful Country that honours our Indigenous Peoples. 🇨🇦 It should be noted Iran is the home of the Baha'i Faith, where the Baha'is have endured fanatic persecution since 1844. The Bab, like John the Baptist, was martyred July 9 1850 in Tabriz, shot by 750 soldiers Twice, with thousands of followers being martyred, and still being persecuted to this day. The Baha’i World Centre is in Haifa Israel on the side of Mount Carmel, where the Shrine of the Bab, the Archives Building and UHJ Building are located surrounded by the magnificent gardens. The Baha’i Faith is now the 2nd most wide spread Religion in the World. With an abundance of the original Holy Writings, there is no need for clergy. The administration for the Local, National and International levels with 9 members each, is based on the writings the Baha’i Faith. None should seek or promote others for office, only through individual prayer and medication we vote. Individuals are chosen for their character, ability and service. Every year the Local and National Spiritual Assemblies are elected, and every 5 years all National Spiritual Assemblies gather together in Haifa to elect from the the entire Baha’i World Community, the 9 members to serve on the Universal House of Justice. First elected April 21,1963 in Haifa with a following World Congress in London Eng, my brother attending., ALL-INCLUSIVE, SIMPLE, PURE & EFFECTIVE. 🇨🇦 During the early 1960s I lived on the prosperous Kahnawake Reserve south of Montreal, visiting many Reserves enjoying learning about our 1st Nation Peoples. Interestingly Northern Canada represents 48% of Canadas land area, with only about 130K people, with Canadas population just over 40M. Many 1st. Nations and Metis live in the Near North with the Inuit in the Far North above the tree line. There are three territories, The Yukon, capital White house, Northwest Territories, capital Yellow Knife and in the Far North, Nunavut, capital Iqaluit. All have elected Governments supported by our Federal Government. Most of these lands are owned by our Indigenous peoples, as well as other lands throughout Canada. The Inuit peoples first came from Siberia to Alaska 1000s of years ago, slowly spreading east to Canada, Greenland and more recently Denmark, all sharing much the same culture, language and religion. Pop; Alaska 18K, Canada 72K, Greenland 53k, Denmark 19K. In Canada, the 1st Nation Peoples number 1.7M and Metis 6.7K 🇨🇦 "THE EARTH IS BUT ONE COUNTRY AND MANKIND ITS CITIZENS”
